items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: there was Art Tatum with his trio, with Slam Stewart and Tiny Grimes

ctx.x: Oh, I have something funny to tell you about that. As soon as we got to New York and got established where we were going to stay, or live, and in those days New York was so beautiful, I knew then I was never going to go back to Chicago. Just to see my people and my father and whatever, but I wasn't about to go back to the midwest, because there was a warmness about New York, and an excitement. Your blood started circulating. That's the only way I can describe it, you know. And John and I, we just -- we had a good…
What year was this, when you got to New York?
